verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The workflow explicitly checks out the immutable PR head SHA with full history, fails closed if either the base ref or checked-out HEAD violates its assumptions, records the exact base SHA graded, and runs the real C1 guard only after a clean merge. The tests pin the load-bearing checkout, HEAD verification, base merge, clean-merge gate, published SHA, merge-group backstop, permissions, and required-check behavior. This is materially unchanged from the already-clean round 3 result, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
